correctness.rationale: For t=2^p, block form D=[0,1^T;1,t(J-I)+(1-t)A_Cn]. The zero-sum subspace splits orthogonally into radial hub/rim-constant and n-1 rim zero-mean Fourier modes, with Rayleigh eigenvalues [2(n-1)-(n-3)t]/(n+1) and t+2(t-1)cos(2pi k/n). The latter minimum 2c-(2c-1)t is no larger than radial (strict if t>1), since c=1 even or cos(pi/n) odd. Its one/two real null modes at t=2c/(2c-1) give critical Gram ranks n-1/n-2. All p>=0 and n>=4 follow analytically. The odd-n expansion follows from cos(pi/n). Independent numeric 85 spectral reconstructions were checked; these are not an all-n proof.
residual_risks: Finite spectral checks do not certify all integer n; reliance on elementary Fourier decomposition and positivity of radial margin.
